text: dsh-channel-wechat 是把微信 iLink（ClawBot）接入 DeepSeek Harness 的通道插件，提供 Web/桌面插件页和命令行登录入口。它在 DSH 中启动微信消息轮询并将微信消息接入对应会话，把模型回复送回微信。用户可以扫码登录、收发文本与媒体、在微信中使用会话命令、回答审批和提问卡，并配置工作目录、模型、权限与卡片投递方式。长回复会切分为多条消息，诊断信息写入终端和插件日志。适合希望从微信继续使用 DSH 会话并在聊天中完成确认的用户；需要微信扫码登录、DSH 和绝对路径工作目录。

dsh-channel-wechat connects WeChat iLink to DSH sessions. It relays chat messages and model replies, supports QR login and in-chat interaction cards, and splits long replies into messages. Use it to continue DSH conversations from WeChat; it requires a WeChat login and an absolute working directory.

dsh-channel-wechat 的功能「微信消息与 DSH 会话桥接」：收到的微信消息进入按联系人关联的 DSH 会话，模型完成回复后再发送回微信。。通过微信消息或对应交互触发，结果返回微信。
dsh-channel-wechat 的功能「审批与提问卡」：DSH 的审批和用户提问卡可转发到微信，用户在聊天中作答以继续会话。。通过微信消息或对应交互触发，结果返回微信。
dsh-channel-wechat 的功能「微信命令与会话操作」：用户可通过微信内命令访问会话操作和模型配置等能力。。通过微信消息或对应交互触发，结果返回微信。
dsh-channel-wechat 的功能「长回复分段发送」：超出单条消息长度的回复按段落、换行或句子边界切分，并处理跨段代码围栏。。通过微信消息或对应交互触发，结果返回微信。
手机不在电脑旁时，怎样从微信继续和 DSH 助手对话？
I want my assistant replies delivered back to WeChat.

把微信（腾讯 iLink / ClawBot）接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的通道插件。它以一个 npm 包同时提供 Harness bundle 和 GUI 浏览器端，运行在 Harness 进程内。
dsh-channel-wechat README · dsh-channel-wechat：**这个插件的重点不是功能清单的长度，而是消息不丢。** 一轮结束时的回答才发出（旁白和工具参数不会被当成回答），超长正文按段落切开而不是整条被服务端拒绝，`ret: -2` 限流按 2s→4s→8s→16s 退避而不是重试三次后静默丢弃。这三条都有测试钉住，改坏时 CI 会失败。
dsh-channel-wechat README · dsh-channel-wechat：| 微信里对话 | 微信里审批 | 插件页 | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | 直接在聊天里问、让它干活，回复回到微信 | 审批卡和提问卡转发到微信，回复编号即可 | 扫码登录、工作目录、卡片投递位置、权限、模型 |

dsh-channel-wechat README · 能做什么：- 微信文本、图片、文件等消息与 DSH 双向收发。
- 微信消息进入 DSH 会话，回复从 `session/event` 回到微信。
- 微信内置命令（`/help`、`/skills`、`/cwd`、`/models`、`/model`、`/status`、`/stop`、`/new`）、审批卡和提问卡。
- 只有扫码登录的那个微信号能驱动这个机器人；其他人发来的消息不建会话、不执行命令、也不回复。
- `/cwd <绝对路径>` 在微信里切换工作目录：结束当前会话，在新目录开始新对话，切换跨重启保留。
- 审批卡可直接把当前会话切到完全权限；生成期间微信显示「对方正在输入」。
- 提问卡的答案可以是选项编号，也可以是你自己写的话；卡片上的 `0` 表示「换到对话里说」，整张卡随即作废。
- 多张卡片同时出现时一次只显示一张（标题带「第 N/M 张」），答完当前这张再发下一张；`/stop` 会一次性作废该会话所有待确认的卡片。
- GUI 插件页扫码登录、退出登录、配置工作目录、卡片投递方式、模型和权限。
- 长轮询与会话处理解耦；诊断写入终端和插件日志。
dsh-channel-wechat README · 能做什么：群聊、运行期多账号、主动推送和独立权限系统不在当前范围内。

dsh-channel-wechat README · 快速开始：1. 确认 profile 已有一个你希望用于微信会话的工作目录。
2. 安装插件并重启 DSH：

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-channel-wechat
   ```

3. 打开 GUI 的 **Plugins → dsh-channel-wechat**，点击登录微信，使用手机扫码；需要验证码时在页面输入。
4. 从微信向 bot 发一条消息，确认 DSH 回复返回微信。

安装后必须完全退出并重启 DSH，宿主才能发现浏览器端配置页。刚发布版本若被 pnpm 的观察期跳过，可使用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-channel-wechat@latest --config.minimumReleaseAge=0
```

dsh-channel-wechat README · 配置：GUI 页面可编辑全部配置。也可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中写：

```yaml
- id: channel-wechat
  config:
    cwd: /你的/工作目录
    cards: wechat

`cwd` 必须是绝对路径；它在会话创建时写入且不可变，修改只影响之后的新会话。完整字段、默认值和权限边界见 [配置参考](./docs/configuration.md)。

`allow` 决定谁能用这个机器人。留空时只放行扫码登录的那个账号，这是零配置的默认值；要授权别人，在插件页的「允许使用的人」里一行填一个微信 id。填入名单后**以名单为准**，登录者不再自动包含——被拒的消息不会回复，只在插件日志里留一行带对方 id 的记录，那个 id 就是填进名单的值。

没有 web app 的 profile 可以使用终端登录：

```bash
dsh <profile> login
dsh <profile> status
dsh <profile> logout
```
dsh-channel-wechat README · 配置：web/desktop profile 的启动器会先拒绝 `login` 位置参数，请改用 GUI 登录。

dsh-channel-wechat README · 数据与日志：| 内容 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 会话记录 | `~/.dsh/sessions/<cwd 转义>/channel-wechat-<peerId>[~g<N>]/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` |
| 插件状态 | `~/.dsh/channel-wechat/` |
| 诊断日志 | `~/.dsh/channel-wechat/log/channel-wechat-YYYY-MM-DD.log`，保留 7 天 |
| 登录凭证 | `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` |

聊天记录由 DSH 持久化，`/new` 只创建新的会话代次，不删除旧记录。排障时不要分享 token、Cookie 或凭证文件内容。

dsh-channel-wechat README · 常见问题：- **插件页没有配置区**：完全退出并重新打开 DSH，见 [故障排查](./docs/troubleshooting.md)。
- **登录命令报参数错误**：web/desktop 只支持 GUI 登录。
- **消息没有回复**：先查插件日志、账号状态和 `cwd` 是否为绝对路径。
- **引用或媒体降级为文本**：部分引用字段和服务端 uint64 消息 id 是已记录限制，详见故障排查。

dsh-channel-wechat README · dsh-channel-wechat：A channel plugin that connects WeChat (Tencent iLink / ClawBot) to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). One npm package provides both the Harness bundle and the GUI browser half; it runs inside the Harness process.

dsh-channel-wechat README · dsh-channel-wechat：**What sets this apart from the other WeChat channels is not more features — it is that messages do not go missing.** Only the turn's final answer is sent, so narration and tool arguments are never posted as replies; an over-long answer is split on paragraph boundaries instead of being rejected whole; a `ret: -2` rate limit backs off 2s→4s→8s→16s instead of being dropped silently after three one-second retries. Tests pin all three, so CI fails when a change breaks them.

dsh-channel-wechat README · dsh-channel-wechat：| In WeChat | Approval card | Plugin page | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Ask and assign work in the chat; replies come back to WeChat | Approval and question cards are relayed to WeChat; reply with a number | QR login, working directory, card placement, permission, model |

dsh-channel-wechat README · What it supports：- Two-way text, image, and file messaging.
- Inbound WeChat messages become DSH turns; durable `session/event` messages are sent back to WeChat.
- Commands in WeChat (`/help`, `/skills`, `/cwd`, `/models`, `/model`, `/status`, `/stop`, `/new`), approval cards, and question cards.
- Only the WeChat account that scanned the login can drive the bot; messages from anyone else create no session, run no command, and get no reply.
- `/cwd <absolute-path>` switches the working directory from WeChat: the current conversation ends and a new one starts in that directory, and the choice survives a restart.
- An approval card can switch the current conversation to full access; WeChat shows "typing" while a turn runs.
- A question card accepts either an option number or your own words; `0` on the card means "talk it over instead" and closes the card.
- When several cards arrive at once, only one is shown at a time, headed "N of M", and the next follows once you answer; `/stop` withdraws every card waiting in that conversation.
- QR login, sign-out, working directory, card delivery, model, and permission settings on the GUI plugin page.
- Long polling
dsh-channel-wechat README · What it supports：Group chats, multiple accounts at runtime, unsolicited push, and a separate permission system are out of scope.

dsh-channel-wechat README · Quick start：1. Make sure the profile has a working directory you want to use for WeChat sessions.
2. Install the plugin and restart DSH:

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-channel-wechat
   ```

3. Open **Plugins → dsh-channel-wechat** in the GUI, click **Sign in to WeChat**, and scan the QR code. Enter a verify code on the page if requested.
4. Send a message to the bot from WeChat and confirm that the DSH reply arrives there.

dsh-channel-wechat README · Quick start：A full DSH restart is required after installation so the host can discover the browser half. If pnpm's observation window skips a just-published release, use:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-channel-wechat@latest --config.minimumReleaseAge=0
```

dsh-channel-wechat README · Configuration：The GUI page edits all fields. The same values can be written in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: channel-wechat
  config:
    cwd: /your/workspace
    cards: wechat

`cwd` must be absolute. It is recorded when a session is created and cannot be changed for that session; edits affect sessions created afterwards. See [configuration reference](./docs/configuration.md) for fields, defaults, and permission boundaries.

dsh-channel-wechat README · Configuration：`allow` decides who may use the bot. Empty admits only the account that scanned the login, which is the zero-configuration default; to admit others, put one WeChat id per line in "Who may use this bot" on the plugin page. A non-empty list is authoritative — the logged-in account is no longer included automatically. A refused message gets no reply; the plugin log keeps one line with the sender's id, which is the value to paste into the list.

Profiles without a web app can use the terminal:

dsh-channel-wechat README · Configuration：```bash
dsh <profile> login
dsh <profile> status
dsh <profile> logout
```

On web/desktop profiles the launcher rejects the `login` positional argument before this plugin runs; use the GUI instead.

dsh-channel-wechat README · Data and logs：| What | Location |
|---|---|
| Session transcript | `~/.dsh/sessions/<escaped cwd>/channel-wechat-<peerId>[~g<N>]/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` |
| Plugin state | `~/.dsh/channel-wechat/` |
| Diagnostic log | `~/.dsh/channel-wechat/log/channel-wechat-YYYY-MM-DD.log`, kept 7 days |
| Login credential | `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` |

dsh-channel-wechat README · Data and logs：DSH persists the transcript. `/new` creates a new conversation generation and does not delete older records. Never share tokens, cookies, or credential files when reporting an issue.

dsh-channel-wechat README · Troubleshooting：- **No configuration section**: fully quit and reopen DSH; see [troubleshooting](./docs/troubleshooting.md).
- **Login argument rejected**: web/desktop profiles support GUI login only.
- **No reply**: check the plugin log, account status, and that `cwd` is absolute.
- **Media or quote degraded to text**: some quote fields and the server's uint64 message id are known limitations; see troubleshooting.
